items.summary: Preserve voice setting support in SynthDriver under automatic profiles
items.fullMessage:
Preserve voice setting support in SynthDriver under automatic profiles

- Override SynthDriver.isSupported() to always report True for the "voice" setting even when Automatic Language Profiles hides voice controls from supportedSettings.
- Ensure NVDA's SynthDriver.loadSettings() initializes the active configured voice via changeVoice(self, voice) instead of passing None.

Beta to master (#20837)
